UPSSSC Senior Instructor Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Senior Instructor on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 132 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 will start from 14 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSSSC Senior Instructor Online Form 2026?

UPSSSC Senior Instructor Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 05 October 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://upsssc.gov.in/ViewPdf.aspx?tNvBgZ+yjQmqFNjufVqIZyUYRzsOqzXGey/v8e79hqs=

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
